authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed public application source, versioned API/database contracts, and exact private deployment candidate identities.
authority.task_authority: GitHub issues and cutover specifications with explicit authentication, authorization, migration, and live-flow acceptance criteria.
authority.acceptance_authority: Public source validation plus disposable browser/API integration, negative authorization tests, migration evidence, and protected live probes.
authority.deployment_authority: Private Wardriver-owned protected workflows and environment identity; public source workflows have no production mutation authority.

data.retention: Account, upload, scan-derived, membership, and audit data is retained only under explicit product purpose, user expectation, and operational policy.
data.deletion: Account deletion, test-environment teardown, pre-user reset, and policy expiry remove or tombstone associated records and derived access paths.
data.secret_storage: Authentication secrets, database credentials, signing material, and production endpoints remain in private protected deployment environments.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Before real users, failed cutover may reset and redeploy the environment; after user admission, schema/data revocation and recovery require separately qualified evidence.

stabilization.summary: Complete the private Wardriver-owned cutover and remove every legacy public Azure mutation credential and workflow.
Add disposable browser/API authentication flows, negative authorization tests, CSRF/session checks, and exact environment receipts.
Qualify schema migration, fresh-environment reset, live probes, and post-user recovery as separate evidence classes.
